name: github-runners-for-repo.workflow
description: Workflow manifest for the github-runners-for-repo brownfield tooling repository. References the canonical 8-check GH Actions pipeline declared in .github/workflows/. autobahn consumes this manifest as the source of truth for required work products and gate inputs.

phases.name: Bootstrap
phases.description: Inspect repo, identify stack, capture brownfield profile. Produces .ai/init/* and .ai/matrix.json.

phases.name: Spec & Plan
phases.description: Convert intent into a spec and a sequenced plan. For brownfield repos with no hosted tracker, plan lives in the PR description and tracks in .omc/plans.

phases.name: Implement
phases.description: Make the change with the smallest viable diff. Mirror CI locally via pre-commit.

phases.name: Verify & Ship
phases.description: Run all 8 CI checks, ensure coverage stays >=95%, merge via admin --squash on the merge-deadlock pattern.

required_checks.name: lint
required_checks.command: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .

required_checks.name: deptry-pip-audit
required_checks.command: uv run deptry . && uv run pip-audit

merge_deadlock_workaround.rationale: Single-owner repos hit self-approval blocks on the only reviewer. Workaround documented in .omc/project-memory.json (merge-deadlock-pattern).
